rules.description:
[⌥]+[⌥]:
---
	On Tap:
		Always:	Emit ⌃> + '/'

[CAPS] layer:
---
	On Tap:
		Always:	Emit ⌘⌥⌃⇧ + 'F15'
	On Hold:
		Alone:	Emit ⌘⌥⌃⇧ + key
		With ⇧:	Emit ⌘⌥⌃ + key
		With ⌃:	Emit ⌘⌥⇧ + key
		With ⌥:	Emit ⌘⌃⇧ + key
		With ⌘:	Emit ⌥⌃⇧ + key
		(the held modifier is consumed by the layer; two of them fall through)
		(where a rule already exists for that combination, it runs instead)

[⌘⌥⌃⇧]+[,]:
---
	On Tap:
		Always:	open System Settings

[⌘⌥⌃⇧]+[E]:
---
	On Tap:
		Always:	map 'focus window to the right'

[⌘⌥⌃⇧]+[␛]:
---
	On Tap:
		Always:	open Activity Monitor

[⌘⌥⌃⇧]+[F]:
---
	On Tap:
		Always:	map 'focus window to the bottom'

[⌘⌥⌃⇧]+[F12]:
---
	On Tap:
		Always:	Run command 'edit last Typinator expansion'

[⌘⌥⌃⇧]+[KEYPAD 1]:
---
	On Tap:
		Always:	Open 'Window to bottom left 1/8'

[⌘⌥⌃⇧]+[KEYPAD 3]:
---
	On Tap:
		Always:	Open 'Window to bottom right 1/8'

[⌘⌥⌃⇧]+[KEYPAD 5]:
---
	On Tap:
		Always:	Open 'window ✥'

[⌘⌥⌃⇧]+[KEYPAD 7]:
---
	On Tap:
		Always:	Open 'Window to top left 1/8'

[⌘⌥⌃⇧]+[KEYPAD 9]:
---
	On Tap:
		Always:	Open 'Window to top right 1/8'

[⌘⌥⌃⇧]+[←]:
---
	On Tap:
		Always:	Open 'window to top-left 1/2'
	On Hold:
		Always:	Open 'app to display ←'

[⌘⌥⌃⇧]+[Q]:
---
	On Tap:
		Always:	map 'focus window to the left'

[⌘⌥⌃⇧]+[R]:
---
	On Tap:
		Always:	map 'focus window to the top'

[⌘⌥⌃⇧]+[→]:
---
	On Tap:
		Always:	Open 'window to bottom-right 1/2'
	On Hold:
		Always:	Open 'app to display →'

[⌘⌥⌃⇧]+[S]:
---
	On Tap:
		Always:	Open 'format selected text'

[⌘⌥⌃⇧]+[␣]:
---
	On Tap:
		Always:	Open 'toggle maximize and restore window'

[⌘⌥⌃⇧]+[T]:
---
	On Tap:
		Always:	Run command 'create new Typinator rule'
	On Hold:
		Always:	Run command 'edit last Typinator expansion'

[⌘⌥⌃⇧]+[⇥]:
---
	On Tap:
		Always:	Open 'app to display →'

[⌘⌥⌃]+[KEYPAD 5]:
---
	On Tap:
		Always:	Open 'toggle maximize and restore window'

[⌘⌥]+[H]:
---
	On Tap:
		Always:	No operation

[⌘⌥]+[M]:
---
	On Tap:
		Always:	No operation

[⌘⇧]+[←]:
---
	On Tap:
		In Zen:	map 'activate next tab in Zen'

[⌘⇧]+[P]:
---
	On Tap:
		In Microsoft Excel:	map 'search Excel commands'

[⌘⇧]+[→]:
---
	On Tap:
		In Zen:	map 'activate previous tab in Zen'

[⌘>]+[A]:
---
	On Tap:
		Always:	open Antinote

[⌘]+[D]:
---
	On Tap:
		In Antinote:	Emit ⌘ + 'D'

[⌘]+[H]:
---
	On Tap:
		In Skim:	map 'highlight in skim'
		Always:	No operation

[⌘]+[M]:
---
	On Hold:
		Always:	map 'restore minimized windows'

[⌘>]+[O]:
---
	On Tap:
		Always:	open Microsoft Outlook

[⌘]+[P]:
---
	On Tap:
		In Word:	Run command 'get file path and print in word'
	On Hold:
		Always:	map 'show showPopclip'

[⌘]+[Q]:
---
	On Tap:
		Always:	Emit ⌘ + 'Q'

[⌘]+[/]:
---
	On Tap:
		In Security Agent/System Settings/System Settings, security/System Settings, updates/Brew auto-updater/Taphouse and UI element role is and UI element subrole is:	Run command 'fill password'
		In Security Agent/System Settings/System Settings, security/System Settings, updates/Brew auto-updater/Taphouse and UI element role is and not UI element subrole is:	Run command 'fill username and password'
		In Word:	Run command 'get file path in word'

rules.description:
[⌘]+[U]:
---
	On Tap:
		In Skim:	map 'underline in skim'

[⌥>]+[K]:
---
	On Hold:
		Always:	Context action: kitty

[⌥>]+[S]:
---
	On Tap:
		Always:	Run command 'open Spotify or toggle play/pause'
	On Hold:
		Always:	Call 'search Spotify'

to_if_alone.shell_command: if pgrep -x 'Spotify' > "/dev/null;" then open 'raycast-x://extensions/mattisssa/spotify-player/togglePlayPause'; else '/Users/jason/.local/bin/open-app' -b 'com.spotify.client'; fi; echo 'Spotify toggled'

to_if_canceled.shell_command: if pgrep -x 'Spotify' > "/dev/null;" then open 'raycast-x://extensions/mattisssa/spotify-player/togglePlayPause'; else '/Users/jason/.local/bin/open-app' -b 'com.spotify.client'; fi; echo 'Spotify toggled'

rules.description:
[⌃]+[␛]:
---
	On Tap:
		Always:	open Activity Monitor
	On Hold:
		Always:	open Process Spy

[⇧]+[A]:
---
	On Hold:
		Always:	Open 'create a new note in Antinote'

[⇧]+[END]:
---
	On Tap:
		Always:	map 'select text to the right of cursor'

[⇧]+[HOME]:
---
	On Tap:
		Always:	map 'select text to the left of cursor'

[⇧]+[M]:
---
	On Hold:
		Always:	map 'show menu items'

[⇧]+[S]:
---
	On Hold:
		Always:	capture a screenshot of a window using CSX

[8]:
---
	On Hold:
		Always:	open RingCentral

[A]:
---
	On Hold:
		Always:	Emit ⌘⌥⌃⇧ + 'F18'

[C]:
---
	On Hold:
		Always:	open-shell Claude

[D]:
---
	On Hold:
		Always:	Emit ⌘⌥⇧ + 'F1'

[END]:
---
	On Tap:
		Always:	Emit ⌘ + '→'

[=]:
---
	On Tap:
		Always:	Emit 'PAD ='
	On Hold:
		Always:	map 'select word backward' then Run command 'insert today's date in yyyy-mm-dd format at the cursor'

[␛]:
---
	On Tap:
		Always:	Emit '␛'
	On Hold:
		Always:	Run command 'kill front app'
	On Double Tap Hold:
		Always:	Run command 'kill all applications'

[F]:
---
	On Hold:
		Always:	Context action: qspace

[F1]:
---
	On Hold:
		Always:	Emit 'DISPLAY BRIGHTNESS DECREMENT'

[F2]:
---
	On Hold:
		Always:	Emit 'DISPLAY BRIGHTNESS INCREMENT'

[F3]:
---
	On Hold:
		Always:	Emit 'MISSION CONTROL'

[F4]:
---
	On Hold:
		Always:	Emit 'LAUNCHPAD'

[F5]:
---
	On Hold:
		Always:	Emit ⌘⌥⌃ + 'F5'

[F7]:
---
	On Hold:
		Always:	Emit 'REWIND'

[F8]:
---
	On Hold:
		Always:	Emit 'PLAY OR PAUSE'

[F9]:
---
	On Hold:
		Always:	Emit 'FASTFORWARD'

[F10]:
---
	On Hold:
		Always:	Emit 'MUTE'

[F11]:
---
	On Hold:
		Always:	Emit 'VOLUME DECREMENT'

[F12]:
---
	On Hold:
		Always:	Emit 'VOLUME INCREMENT'

[G]:
---
	On Hold:
		Always:	map 'show glyphlow'

[~]:
---
	On Hold:
		Always:	map 'show showPopclip'

[H]:
---
	On Hold:
		Always:	Call 'call Raycast Here2There'

[HOME]:
---
	On Tap:
		Always:	Emit ⌘ + '←'

[J]:
---
	On Hold:
		Always:	Call 'show recent downloads'

[K]:
---
	On Hold:
		Always:	open Kitty

[KEYPAD 0]:
---
	On Hold:
		Always:	Open 'unstash all'

[KEYPAD 2]:
---
	On Hold:
		Always:	Open 'stash ↓'

[KEYPAD 4]:
---
	On Hold:
		Always:	Open 'stash ←'

[KEYPAD 5]:
---
	On Hold:
		Always:	Open 'unstash'

[KEYPAD 6]:
---
	On Hold:
		Always:	Open 'stash →'

[KEYPAD 8]:
---
	On Hold:
		Always:	Open 'stash ↑'

[⏎]:
---
	On Tap:
		Always:	Emit '⏎'
	On Hold:
		Outside Microsoft Excel:	Open 'format substring of selected text'
		In Microsoft Excel:	Emit 'F2'

[PAD =]:
---
	On Tap:
		Always:	Emit 'PAD ='
	On Hold:
		Always:	map 'select word backward' then Run command 'insert today's date in yyyy-mm-dd format at the cursor'

[⌘]:
---
	On Tap:
		not Caps lock pressed:	Emit '⌘'
	On Hold:
		not Caps lock pressed:	Emit '⌘'
	On Double Tap:
		not Caps lock pressed:	Go back 1 apps

[⇧]:
---
	On Tap:
		not Caps lock pressed:	Emit '⇧'
	On Hold:
		not Caps lock pressed:	Emit '⇧'
	On Double Tap:
		not Caps lock pressed:	Call 'open Raycast clipboard manager'

[M]:
---
	On Hold:
		Always:	map 'restore minimized windows'

[N]:
---
	On Hold:
		Always:	Run command 'activate Neru's hints mode'

[O]:
---
	On Hold:

[P]:
---
	On Hold:
		Always:	map 'show showPopclip'

[Q]:
---
	On Hold:
		Always:	open QSpace

[R]:
---
	On Hold:
		Always:	Run command 'get recent items from Raycast'

[⏎]:
---
	On Tap:
		Always:	Emit '⏎'
	On Hold:
		Outside Microsoft Excel:	Open 'format substring of selected text'
		In Microsoft Excel:	Emit 'F2'

[⇧]:
---
	On Tap:
		not Caps lock pressed:	Emit '⇧'
	On Hold:
		not Caps lock pressed:	Emit '⇧'
	On Double Tap:
		not Caps lock pressed:	Call 'open Raycast clipboard manager'

[S]:
---
	On Hold:
		Always:	capture a screenshot of an area using CSX

[/]:
---
	On Hold:
		Always:	map 'raycast here2this'

[T]:
---
	On Hold:
		Always:	map 'show kitty quake terminal'

[⇥]:
---
	On Hold:
		Always:	Emit 'MISSION CONTROL'

[V]:
---
	On Hold:
		Always:	Call 'open Raycast clipboard manager'

[X]:
---
	On Hold:
		Always:	Context action: copy

[Y]:
---
	On Hold:
		Always:	Context action: copy

[Z]:
---
	On Hold:
		Always:	Call 'search directories using zoxide'
